caption:
Selling baby gates? There's a CPSC rule just for them: 16 CFR part 1239.
It says each gate and enclosure must comply with ASTM F1004. Since July 20, 2026, the rule cites the 2025 version, F1004-25. Before that, it cited F1004-22.
The certificate lists each applicable rule separately (16 CFR 1110.11(a)(2)).
If 1239 isn't on yours, that's a gap to close.
Want a free gap list? Comment M&Z and we'll DM you the link.

sources.quote: Each gate and enclosure must comply with all applicable provisions of ASTM F1004-25, Standard Consumer Safety Specification for Expansion Gates and Expandable Enclosures, approved on December 1, 2025.

Link to an amendment published at 91 FR 16166, Apr. 1, 2026. Each gate and enclosure must comply with all applicable provisions of ASTM F1004-22, Standard Consumer Safety Specification for Expansion Gates and Expandable Enclosures, approved on June 1, 2022.
Finished product certificates must identify separately all applicable rules, bans, standards, or regulations.
